title: Customer Success Metrics That Actually Predict Retention
summary: Analysis of 500+ B2B SaaS companies reveals that product usage depth (not breadth), support ticket sentiment, and expansion revenue velocity are the top 3 predictors of renewal. NPS alone correlates weakly with actual churn.
content: Analysis of 500+ B2B SaaS companies reveals that product usage depth (not breadth), support ticket sentiment, and expansion revenue velocity are the top 3 predictors of renewal.
